newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares seen rising moderately next week.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares seen rising moderately next week.

text.p: Danish share prices closed higher on Friday with dealers seeing possible modest rises in thin trade on Monday provided Wall Street performed positively.
"If the U.S. market rises as it does just now and bonds hold, I think we will see moderate rises in Danish shares on Monday. At last it was the KFX index which rose today," one dealer said.

The KFX top-20 index closed 0.80 point higher at 153.46 in overall bourse turnover of 1.123 billion crowns. The KFX June future rose 0.30 point to 152.20 with 40 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
A.P. Moeller attracted a lot of attention, helping the index to end up. D/S 1912 closed 4,000 crowns higher at 198,000 and D/S Svendborg finished 2,000 crowns better off at 285,000 crowns.
Radiometer shed 25 crowns to end at 370 on its downard adjustment of 1996/97 result expectations.
